notes:
What's new

- Comics read as comics: .cbz and .cbr open as full pages instead of a file list.
- Turn pages with the arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Space or the mouse wheel; the counter shows PAGE 3 / 40.
- Pages are sorted in reading order (page 2 before page 10) and scaled to fill the window, with only one page held in memory.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.19 - comic page viewer (1D, part 2). CBZ/CBR list image entries from the archive backend with natural sorting, extract one page at a time to %TEMP% for WIC decoding, and fit each page to the window with a reserved counter band. Arrow/PageUp/PageDown/Space/wheel paging, last-page stop, plain-zip fallback. 11 new checks.
